$comment: The curated development dataset of dev.orochia.com (npm run dev:dataset). Fictional creators, one niche each, titles that say what the footage shows. Every clip is made by Orazaka (its run id is read from the media folder's manifest.json at seed time and written in the video's description); nothing here is a real person, and the clips show no face. More creators = more entries here, each with its own QA credentials (key names of the QA env file).

creators.bio: Night sessions: live jazz, rainy city streets and fires with a guitar. New clip every week.
Kitchen, beach days and summer evenings: what I cook, where we dance, what we wear.
Trails, harbours and deserts: slow travel, filmed where the signal ends.
Strength and mobility, five minutes at a time, before the city wakes up.
Ink, paint and walls: process clips from a Montreal studio.
